proof_body:
by
  intro u v hu hv
  have hconv := Complex.betaIntegral_convergent (u := (u:ℂ)) (v := (v:ℂ)) (by simpa using hu) (by simpa using hv)
  have hcongr : ∀ x ∈ Set.uIoc (0:ℝ) 1, ((x:ℂ) ^ ((u:ℂ) - 1) * (1 - (x:ℂ)) ^ ((v:ℂ) - 1)) = (((x ^ (u - 1) * (1 - x) ^ (v - 1) : ℝ)) : ℂ) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Set.uIoc_of_le zero_le_one] at hx
    have hx0 : 0 ≤ x := hx.1.le
    have hx1 : 0 ≤ 1 - x := by linarith [hx.2]
    push_cast
    rw [Complex.ofReal_cpow hx0, Complex.ofReal_cpow hx1]
    push_cast
    rfl
  have hint : IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => (((x ^ (u - 1) * (1 - x) ^ (v - 1) : ℝ)) : ℂ)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
    hconv.congr hcongr
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [intervalIntegrable_iff] at hint ⊢
    have h := hint.re
    simpa [MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn] using h
  · have h1 := Complex.betaIntegral_eq_Gamma_mul_div (u:ℂ) (v:ℂ) (by simpa using hu) (by simpa using hv)
    have h2 : Complex.betaIntegral (u:ℂ) (v:ℂ) = ((∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, x ^ (u - 1) * (1 - x) ^ (v - 1) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      rw [Complex.betaIntegral, intervalIntegral.integral_congr_ae (g := fun x : ℝ => (((x ^ (u - 1) * (1 - x) ^ (v - 1) : ℝ)) : ℂ)) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hcongr), intervalIntegral.integral_ofReal]
    rw [h2] at h1
    have h3 : ((u:ℂ) + (v:ℂ)) = ((u + v : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; rfl
    rw [h3, Complex.Gamma_ofReal, Complex.Gamma_ofReal, Complex.Gamma_ofReal] at h1
    exact_mod_cast h1
target_source: ∀ u v : ℝ, 0 < u → 0 < v → IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => x ^ (u - 1) * (1 - x) ^ (v - 1)) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 ∧ ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, x ^ (u - 1) * (1 - x) ^ (v - 1) = Real.Gamma u * Real.Gamma v / Real.Gamma (u + v)
